# GaitParams

Kind: component · Defined in [`src/logic/agents/gait.h`](../../../src/logic/agents/gait.h) · Scene / prefab name: `GaitParams` · Described in `data/agents_motion.json`

The kinematic gait's laws and shapes (angles in radians, lengths in metres).

## Fields

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `step_factor` | `float` | step length / leg length = step_factor * (speed / sqrt(g * leg length)) ^ step_exponent (default 1.11) |
| `step_exponent` | `float` | exponent of that law (default 0.42) |
| `max_stride_time` | `float` | s: the stride never lasts longer (slow walking shortens the step instead) (default 1.6) |
| `stance_share` | `float` | share of the stride a foot is on the ground at reference_speed (clamped to 0.55..0.72) (default 0.62) |
| `stance_share_rate` | `float` | change of stance_share per m/s above reference_speed (default -0.055) |
| `reference_speed` | `float` | m/s at which the amplitudes, angles and stance share are given (default 1.36) |
| `step_width` | `float` | between the sole centres' paths (default 0.14) |
| `flat_start` | `float` | share of the stance at which the heel rocker ends and the sole is flat (default 0.16) |
| `heel_off` | `float` | share of the stance at which the heel lifts (toe rocker) (default 0.5) |
| `strike_angle` | `float` | sole pitch at heel strike at reference_speed, radians (degrees in JSON) (default 0.26) |
| `toe_angle` | `float` | sole pitch at toe-off at reference_speed, radians (degrees in JSON) (default 1.05) |
| `swing_lift` | `float` | m of extra ankle arc in swing (default 0.03) |
| `swing_clearance` | `float` | m: least gap between the sole and the ground in swing (default 0.025) |
| `swing_level` | `float` | share of the swing by which the sole has turned from its toe-off pitch to its landing pitch (default 0.6) |
| `replan_until` | `float` | share of the swing during which the landing is still planned (default 0.6) |
| `max_heel_rise` | `float` | the most the toe rocker pitches the sole, radians (default 1.4) |
| `heel_drop_rate` | `float` | rad/s: how fast a heel raised for reach or for the ankle comes back down (default 2.5) |
| `ankle_margin` | `float` | the heel rises when the ankle is this close to its dorsiflexion stop (default 0.035) |
| `knee_follow` | `float` | in a turn the knee points this share of the way from the pelvis' forward to the foot's (default 0.5) |
| `knee_out` | `float` | the knee points this share of the way from the walker's forward to the foot's toes (default 0.5) |
| `ankle_roll_extra` | `float` | radians added to the ankles' swing limit about the foot's long axis, for the IK only (degrees in JSON; 0: the body file's) (default 0.0) |
| `ankle_yaw_extra` | `float` | radians added to the ankles' swing limit about the sole's normal, for the IK only (degrees in JSON) (default 0.0) |
| `yield_limits` | `bool` | A planted foot comes first: where a leg cannot put its foot on its print inside the joint limits, the limits give way (steep ground). false: the limits always hold and the foot misses its print (default true) |
| `leg_extension` | `float` | most of the thigh + shank length a leg stretches to (the knee keeps 14 degrees) (default 0.992) |
| `hip_height` | `float` | the hips' height over the ankles in mid stance, as a share of that reach (default 1.0) |
| `bob` | `float` | the hips sink this much at each double support, at reference_speed (default 0.035) |
| `crouch_time` | `float` | seconds: how fast the hips settle to the crouch the last step needed (default 0.35) |
| `pelvis_yaw` | `float` | pelvis yaw amplitude at reference_speed, radians (default 0.07) |
| `pelvis_list` | `float` | pelvis list (roll) amplitude at reference_speed, radians (default 0.035) |
| `counter_rotation` | `float` | shoulders turn against the pelvis by this share of its yaw (default 0.6) |
| `lean` | `float` | trunk pitch at reference_speed, radians (default 0.035) |
| `lean_slope_gain` | `float` | trunk pitch per radian of slope along the heading (default 0.5) |
| `arm_swing` | `float` | arm swing amplitude at reference_speed, radians (default 0.32) |
| `arm_bias` | `float` | arms held forward by this at reference_speed, radians (default 0.05) |
| `elbow` | `float` | elbow bend, radians (default 0.17) |
| `elbow_swing` | `float` | extra elbow bend as the arm swings forward, radians (default 0.2) |
| `acceleration` | `float` | m/s2 when speeding up (default 1.0) |
| `turn_rate` | `float` | rad/s toward the commanded heading (default 0.7) |
| `min_speed` | `float` | m/s: a command under it stands (default 0.05) |
| `slope_slowdown` | `float` | the speed walked is the command times exp(-slope_slowdown * \|tan slope\|) (default 1.5) |
| `slope_speed_floor` | `float` | the speed walked is no less than this share of the command, however steep (default 0.25) |
| `step_rise` | `float` | m: the speed is capped so that a step climbs or drops no more than this (0: no cap) (default 0.35) |
| `look_ahead` | `float` | m ahead of the walker where a steeper slope already slows it (default 0.8) |
| `braking` | `float` | m/s2, slowing down (acceleration is for speeding up) (default 2.5) |
| `max_print_rise` | `float` | m between a foot's landing and the other foot's print: the step shortens to keep it (default 0.5) |
| `max_print_tilt` | `float` | radians: steeper ground than this (75 degrees) is stood on at this tilt (default 1.31) |
| `balance_iterations` | `int` | GaitBalance's iterations of the pelvis placement (default 8) |
| `balance_tolerance` | `float` | m of centre of mass error at which GaitBalance stops (default 3e-4) |
| `velocity_smoothing` | `float` | seconds, the centre of mass velocity filter (default 0.08) |
| `scramble` | `bool` | scrambling on (GaitHandIK in the lane): the steeper the ground, the lower the trunk, and a hand within reach of the ground lays its palm flat on it (default false) |
| `scramble_from` | `float` | radians of slope at which the trunk starts coming down (20 degrees; degrees in JSON) (default 0.35) |
| `scramble_full` | `float` | radians of slope at which it is fully down (50 degrees; degrees in JSON) (default 0.87) |
| `scramble_crouch` | `float` | the hips come down by this share of the legs' reach on the steepest ground (default 0.15) |
| `scramble_shoulder` | `float` | m: the trunk tilts toward the slope until the shoulders are this far from the ground (default 0.3) |
| `scramble_lean` | `float` | radians: the most that tilt (degrees in JSON) (default 1.5) |
| `scramble_past` | `float` | radians past lying along the slope the tilt never goes (default 0.5) |
| `scramble_forward` | `float` | m: the most the centre of mass target moves up the slope when the tilt is not enough (the hands take weight) (default 0.45) |
| `scramble_spine` | `float` | radians each of the two spine joints bends for that tilt; the pelvis tips for the rest (default 0.42) |
| `hand_plant_reach` | `float` | a hand takes a hold no further from its shoulder than this share of the arm (default 0.86) |
| `hand_reach` | `float` | a planted hand keeps its hold until the arm is stretched to this share (default 0.97) |
| `hand_behind` | `float` | m behind its shoulder from where a hand moves on to a hold ahead, if there is one (default 0.12) |
| `hand_over` | `float` | radians its arm is outside its limits from where a hand moves on to a hold ahead (default 0.35) |
| `hand_hold` | `float` | seconds a hand holds before it may move on (default 0.4) |
| `hand_time` | `float` | seconds a hand takes to reach a hold, or to go back to its swing (default 0.3) |
| `hand_lift` | `float` | m off the ground on its way (default 0.05) |
| `hand_max_tilt` | `float` | radians: steeper ground than this (85 degrees) is held at this tilt (default 1.48) |
| `trunk_reach` | `float` | radians the trunk leans further so that a planted hand stays within reach (degrees in JSON) (default 0.35) |
| `trunk_return` | `float` | seconds for that lean to go once no hand asks for it (default 0.4) |
| `hand_support` | `float` | the centre of mass target moves this share of the way to each planted palm (default 0.1) |

## Notes

On the rig entity. JSON reads only a subset (step_factor, step_exponent, max_stride_time, stance_share, step_width, strike_angle, toe_angle, swing_lift, swing_clearance, leg_extension, hip_height, lean_slope_gain, acceleration, turn_rate, slope_slowdown, slope_speed_floor, step_rise, knee_out, yield_limits, ankle_roll_extra, ankle_yaw_extra, scramble, scramble_from, scramble_full, scramble_crouch, scramble_lean, scramble_shoulder, hand_time, hand_support, trunk_reach); its angles are in degrees there. Emplaced with defaults by any gait system when missing.
